notes.title: Compatibility with Xbox One, Playstation 4 and Switch GamePad Pro controllers
notes.content:
Hi friends !

We are happy to announce that Wolf's Fury is now natively compatible with the Xbox One, Playstation 4 and Nintendo GamePad Pro controllers.

For those who have not played the game yet, just plug one of the three controllers with a USB cable and start the game and everything should work. If this is not the case, just go to your Steam game library, right click, properties of Wolf's Fury and uncheck "Activate Overlay" and this way it will work for sure.

For others who have already played the game and made a custom configuration via third-party software like JoyToKey, it is necessary to go in game press the F1 key and reset the keyboard and gamepad by default, before doing the other steps to be certain that the keys will be well configured.

We are really happy to finally be able to offer you this feature. This was in our heads for a long time.

Have fun in the world of Wolf's Fury and feel free to write to us if you need help. ;)

P.S : Don't forget that if the configuration we made for you don't fit well to you, it is very simple to change what we've done and create a custom configuration for you with the steam gamepad tool. :D

P.S 2: Do not follow the tutorial that is shown during your first game in the game that shows you how to configure the gamepad. This will be removed in the following weeks via a small update. thanks for your understanding.

notes.title: Xbox One Native Controller on Steam !
notes.content:
Hello, good news ! =D

We just provided an official Steam Xbox One Game Pad configuration for the game. 

We are still testing it and working on it. If you use it, you will maybe need to desactivate the "Steam Overlay" feature in order to make it work. Some computers seem to not accept the controller with this option activated. 

Please note that if you're using this recommended configuration, you don't need to follow the steps indicated on the first tutorial of the game who explains how to configurate the gamepad. We will erase this from the game, if the Steam feature works fine for some days. 

If you already played the game in the past and configured the game in the oldschool way (following the steps we indicated in game), you can just press F1 in game and put the gamepad and keyboard tabs by default. 

We will keep you updated about all this, but normally the game is now compatible with the Xbox One gamepad in a native way !
